name: Mons Mouton plateau
source: Approximate IM-2 (Athena) landing area on the Mons Mouton plateau; former VIPER target region. Verify against the NASA/IM published landing coordinates.
notes: Broad, high plateau ~5 km above surroundings.

name: Connecting Ridge (Shackleton–de Gerlache)
source: Highly illuminated ridge region identified by Bussey et al. 2010, Mazarico et al. 2011, Gläser et al. 2018. Coordinates approximate; refined to the local LOLA high point.
notes: Ridge between Shackleton and de Gerlache craters.

name: Shackleton rim
source: Shackleton rim illuminated-point region (Mazarico et al. 2011). Approximate; refined to local LOLA high point.
notes: Rim of a 21 km crater whose floor is permanently shadowed.

name: de Gerlache rim
source: de Gerlache rim illuminated region (Bussey et al. 2010; Gläser et al. 2018). Approximate; refined to local LOLA high point.

name: Malapert massif
source: Malapert massif summit region, proposed for its Earth view. Approximate; refined to local LOLA high point.

name: Shackleton crater floor (PSR reference)
source: Shackleton crater centre (IAU Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, approximate). Included as a permanently shadowed contrast case, not a landing candidate.
notes: Deep-crater reference for terrain sanity check.

name: Shiv Shakti point (Chandrayaan-3)
notes: Outside the polar DEM tiles used here, so no terrain mask: results are geometry only.

name: Geographic south pole (90°S)
source: Definition. Used for the polar-limit validation checks.
notes: Azimuth 0 here points along the 0° meridian.
